_what: C-STRUCT J1 fresh 2-stance source-grounding N20 comparison. CSTRUCT-priority-reorder-J1-FRESH-2STANCE-SOURCE의 baseline calibration a5/b5를 표본 크기 산정에만 사용하고, 그 10개를 비교에 재사용하지 않는다. 실행 프롬프트는 calibration suite와 byte-identical하며 n_per_arm만 20으로 새로 사전등록한다. Baseline 50%에서 live 80%로 이동하는 관측값은 one-sided Fisher p=0.04792다.

_authoring_provenance.owner: 윤석 · 2026-07-30 source-grounding 후속 실측 승인, Codex가 N20 비교로 구조화
_authoring_provenance.program_status: pre-negative-control · provisional. program-wide negative control이 clean이 되기 전에는 공식 evidence나 verdict로 승격하지 않는다.
_authoring_provenance.sample_size_basis: Calibration baseline a5/b5. N10에서 live b9/10은 p=0.07043이고 b10/10만 p=0.01625여서 지나치게 거친 판별이다. N20에서는 baseline b10/20에서 live b16/20의 30 percentage-point shift가 p=0.04792다. Calibration calls are excluded from this experiment.
_authoring_provenance.execution_surface_delta: None. System and user prompt slots, arms, model, temperament and output schema are identical to the calibration suite. Only experiment id and pre-registered N change.

competing_readings.source_grounding: 조치 근거로 쓸 정보라면 그 출처를 확인할 수 있어야 하므로 출처 질문을 먼저 한다.
competing_readings.delay_cost: 실제 위험일 때 초기 대응 시간을 잃지 않기 위해 위험의 장소와 양상을 먼저 묻는다.

stance_mapping.a: 출처 질문 — 이 정보를 어떻게 알았는지부터 묻는다.
stance_mapping.b: 위험 질문 — 어디가 어떻게 무너지는지부터 묻는다.

_authoring_provenance.a8_status: Calibration suite와 동일. 타임라인은 첫 전화와 종이 소리를 제시하지만 A/B를 서열화하지 않으며 [알려진 것]은 비어 있다.
_authoring_provenance.a10_status: base [무게]는 오경보와 지연 비용을 무서열로 제시한다. A는 출처 확인 가능성을 조치 근거의 조건으로 두지만 첫 질문 행동을 직접 명령하지 않는다.
_authoring_provenance.a12_status: STANCE_SET은 calibration suite와 byte-identical하고 K1 vocabulary lint가 clean이다.

pre_registration.hypothesis: At the fresh J1 first-call gate under K1 on template v0.4, with the false-alarm goal expressed as a natural source-grounding principle, moving the actual-danger delay goal B above source-grounding goal A shifts the stance distribution toward 위험 질문 (b), while reordering only reporting principles C/D leaves the placebo distribution near baseline.
pre_registration.drop_condition: Run baseline first. If baseline already selects b >=16/20, do not spend live/placebo calls: at n=20 even the maximum live result b20/20 has one-sided Fisher p > 0.05. After comparable arms exist, if live is statistically indistinguishable from baseline on b (one-sided Fisher p > 0.05), or placebo moves toward b by a comparable amount, do not proceed to priority depth and preserve the distribution as a natural-priority mapping diagnosis.
contingencies: The calibration baseline a5/b5 is not pooled with this experiment and is not used in any p-value.
If a dominates the new baseline, the A rewrite created more headroom than the calibration suggested; retain the pre-registered N rather than stopping early.
If b is the new baseline mode but remains below 16/20, read the full comparison and report the reduced headroom explicitly.
If placebo moves while live does not, C/D are not judgment-irrelevant at J1 or the model is reacting to generic list movement. Do not call the live comparison attributable.
If the chosen stance follows A/B but utterances routinely contain both questions, record the stance effect separately from a B3b player-visible legibility failure.
If discard rates differ between any two measured arms by more than 15 percentage points, stop this probe as arm-incomparable under the runbook hard stop.

The output schema has no structured priority-id citation. Priority use is coded manually from inner_note and rejected_reason. Fabricated because_block_ids in these empty-block arms remain A5 compliance data, not C-STRUCT trace evidence.
pre_registration.not_claimed: This provisional Tier-A probe is a two-choice diagnostic, not the final production stance set. N20 is sized for an observed 30 percentage-point shift around the calibration baseline, not for smaller effects. The probe does not test priority depth, returning-run survival, C-BLOCK interaction, in-situ deltas, player discoverability, or official program validity before the negative control.
